versions.changelog:
- Change base folder from kyp/works/ to mind/works/ throughout documentation and examples.
- Update all usage instructions, file paths, and grep commands to reflect the new mind/works/ location.
- No functional or feature updates; this version only changes the storage directory names.

Initial release of "works" – a personal project intelligence system.

- Organize ongoing, multi-session projects in dedicated folders under `kyp/works/<slug>/`, each with a structured `work.md`.
- Track concrete next steps, log dated progress, and maintain up-to-date status for each project.
- Cross-link projects to related people, organizations, places, references, inspirations, and related questions (digs).
- Enforce naming and structure conventions for easy searching, updating, and closing of projects.
- Integrate with related skills (Peeps, Orgs, Nooks, Pages, Vibes, Digs) for richer project context and cross-referencing.
